Game Overview

Find the Pets puts players into a adventure experience centered on embark on a thrilling quest to discover 150 delightful hidden pets, from familiar furry friends to amusing meme creatures like Floppa. Uncovering these elusive companions in unexpected places will spark endless joy and laughter as you explore this enchanting world. Can you find them all?

How to Play

The moment-to-moment gameplay in Find the Pets is easy to pick up. Embark on a thrilling quest to discover 150 delightful hidden pets, from familiar furry friends to amusing meme creatures like Floppa.
